headline: Senators’ Cousins leaves game after hit from Capitals’ Chychrun
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Ottawa's Cousins left the game after a hit from Washington's Chychrun, and that Chychrun was not assessed a penalty on the play. Nothing in the report speaks to the severity of the injury or whether Cousins will miss time.

The Senators' numbers suggest they are better than a routine contender, even if they have been a bit unlucky. OTT sits at 11-6-1 and has a 51% expected goal share so far this season, meaning they have created slightly more of the quality chances than they have allowed. Their goals total is 2.2 below what those chances would predict, so the scoring has lagged the play. Goalie play has helped, with a goals saved above expected mark of +1.2, meaning their goaltending has stopped about one more goal than an average goalie would have behind the same shots. WSH is close behind at 9-6-0 with a 51% share, and has been stronger at five-on-five, where it controls 54% of expected goals. Our data does not cover Cousins, so we can't say how much his absence would cost Ottawa. If he is out, that gap in team production is what we'd watch.
